Yukti is sitting at 69th position from the right end of a row of 111 people. If Mukti's position from the left end is 50th, then how many people are there between Mukti and Yukti?
questions.solution: Total people = 111. Yukti's position from right = 69. Yukti's position from left = (111 - 69) + 1 = 43rd. Mukti's position from left = 50th. Number of people between them = (Difference in ranks) - 1 = (50 - 43) - 1 = 7 - 1 = 6. *Note: Based on the logical deduction of the provided options and standard SSC pattern, the correct calculation yields 6 (Option C).*
